summary: Task checkpoint creation in the VMware Ubuntu VM requires /srv/orchestrator-mvp/factory/runtime/tasks to be owned by codex and writable; otherwise task-delivery smoke and compile-goal fail while writing checkpoint context.
symptoms: task-delivery-smoke fails with PermissionError when creating /srv/orchestrator-mvp/factory/runtime/tasks/<task_id>
compile-goal or checkpoint updates fail at atomic_write_json(checkpoint_dir / context.json)
runtime task evidence exists but new task directories cannot be created
root_cause: codex-controlled runtime processes could read existing evidence but could not create new checkpoint directories
